Home Renovation Cost Guide Atlanta

You're looking for a reliable home renovation cost guide in Atlanta, and you've come to the right place. On this site, you can find detailed cost ranges for various home renovation services, and you can request a free, written, and itemized quote for your specific project.

How it Works for Your Home Renovation Project

To get started, you can browse the 2026 cost guide, which was updated in August 2026, to get an idea of the costs involved in different renovation projects, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) or whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). You can then contact Build Heritage through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org to request a personalized quote. The team will respond within one business day.

What You Get and What it Costs

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing, and provides free, written, and itemized quotes. The cost guide advises holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. You can find more information on the services offered and the cost guide on the website.

FAQ

What areas does Build Heritage serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How long does it take to get a quote? You will receive a response within one business day. Is Build Heritage licensed and insured? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

Get your free, itemized quote today
